EDGE CASE: competed for Ireland (IRL) at the 2025 Worlds, not Great Britain, so this medal is outside the standard GBR apportionment. However Wikipedia confirms she was born in Newry, Northern Ireland, and has represented Northern Ireland at the Commonwealth Games (8th in heptathlon at 2018 Gold Coast; silver medal in heptathlon at 2022 Birmingham). Per task instructions for the Ireland/Northern Ireland dual-eligibility nuance, this medal is attributed to Northern Ireland in medals_2025.csv even though it was won under the IRL flag at Worlds.
